## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle composite work combines [灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) Guàndǐng's *Xuán yì* (paralleling *Dà bān niè pán jīng xuán yì* 大般涅槃經玄義 [KR6g0005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0005), T1765) with [道暹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E6%9A%B9) Dàoxiān's Táng-period *Wén jù*, edited and combined by the Japanese scholar [守篤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%88%E7%AF%A4) Shutoku. The work documents the Tiāntái-school *Nièpán* commentary tradition across three centuries and three countries.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (597–1700) reflects the maximum window from Guàndǐng's mature period to the Edo-Japanese editorial work.
